assets.prompt: Gilded Shaft: timber mine headframe, rocky entrance and cart heaped with gold ore
Lumber Camp: working sawmill shed, log stockpiles, toothed saw and timber trestles; no underground mine
Ore Pit: stepped open iron quarry, winch and ore cart with rusty rocks
Quicksilver Seep: alchemical retort house over silver mineral pools, sealed flasks and iron pipes
Brimstone Vent: smoking sulfur extraction works, black vent yellow crystals and protective timber shelter
Crystal Grotto: rocky cavern entrance filled with angular blood-red crystals and a small haul cart
Gem Hollow: rocky excavation with cold cyan gems in the face and a workbench
Fenwick dike: short raised medieval stone and timber causeway, reeds and shallow water at its feet, ruined watch gate
Barrow Camp: opened burial mounds, ragged funeral tents, bone palisade and dim green corpse-fire
Cindermaw: imposing obsidian gate fortress at a volcanic ridge pass, iron teeth, crimson flags, ember fissures, compact isolated gate
Pyrehold: demonic basalt war keep with orange furnace mouths and spiked towers on a small rock footprint
The Wound: gaping molten fissure crowned by a shattered colossal gate and broken Lockstone fragments, crooked scorched roots at the lip
